I've corrected the record: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread to confirm.

- **Old note withdrawn:** I expired the Dock 23 fact in GBrain, and the reason recorded is Pree's correction. GBrain keeps it in the history, but it no longer comes up in lookups.
- **New note saved:** the Gate 47 fact is under the Marrow Agrisupply entity and mentions that it replaces the Dock 23 note. Like the first one, it sits on Pree's private memory page, so other members won't see it in their own lookups unless I save it again as a shared fact.
- **Other copies:** GBrain had no other note about the Marrow inbound lane site, but its search is keyword-only, so a differently worded copy could be missed. My first thread reply and Pree's original Dock 23 post are still in #central-team. Pree's correction is posted there too, so anyone reading the channel will see it.
